writing.modelAnswer:
Dear Chris,
I'm writing to share with you an art class I had in a park last Friday.
Instead of copying pictures in the classroom, we sat on the grass and painted what we saw. I chose the small lake and finished a painting of it, with sunlight dancing on the water and boats resting by the bank. Our teacher liked its lively colours so much that she put it up in our classroom.
More importantly, the class taught me to slow down and notice the beauty around me. Nature, as I now see, is the best art teacher.
How I wish you had been there!
Yours,
Li Hua

highlightExpressions.text: Instead of copying pictures in the classroom, we sat on the grass and painted what we saw.
highlightExpressions.note: Instead of doing... 对比开场，凸显这次经历的特别之处。迁移到任何「与往常不同」的活动分享：Instead of having class indoors, we... / Instead of reading about it, we tried it ourselves.

highlightExpressions.text: with sunlight dancing on the water and boats resting by the bank
highlightExpressions.note: with + 名词 + doing 复合结构给画面加细节，dancing / resting 把静景写活。迁移：描写任何场景都可挂一串 with 结构：with music playing / with everyone laughing。

highlightExpressions.text: Our teacher liked its lively colours so much that she put it up in our classroom.
highlightExpressions.note: so...that 结果句自然带出他人评价，替代干巴巴的 My painting was good。迁移：换动词即可用于任何成果反馈：enjoyed it so much that... / was so moved that...。

highlightExpressions.text: the class taught me to slow down and notice the beauty around me
highlightExpressions.note: 无灵主语 + taught me to... 是写感想的高分框架，比 I think I learned... 紧凑有力。迁移：The trip / The experience / The failure taught me to...。

reviewCard.reader: 英国朋友 Chris（平辈、熟人、当时不在场）
reviewCard.tense: 过去时为主（经历）+ 现在时（感想）
reviewCard.readerWho: Chris 是外国朋友、当时不在场
reviewCard.readerCares: 你到底画了什么、那节课有意思在哪
reviewCard.readerWants: 作品得能「看见」——画的是什么、什么颜色、什么样子
reviewCard.value: 在公园上美术课 = 在生活里发现美（自然与艺术的相遇）

reviewMarks.text: I'm writing to share with you an art class I had in a park last Friday.
reviewMarks.note: 判型落纸：分享经历的邮件开门见山——一句话点出何时何地一堂什么课，题目给定的首句承担的正是这个功能。

reviewMarks.text: Instead of copying pictures in the classroom, we sat on the grass and painted what we saw.
reviewMarks.note: 清单「课是怎么上的」落纸：先给场景，Chris 才看得懂后面的作品从哪来。

reviewMarks.text: I chose the small lake and finished a painting of it, with sunlight dancing on the water and boats resting by the bank.
reviewMarks.note: 要点①「完成的作品」落纸：画了什么 + 两笔画面细节，一句写实。

reviewMarks.text: Our teacher liked its lively colours so much that she put it up in our classroom.
reviewMarks.note: 主时态落纸：上周五的事全程一般过去时（liked / put），叙事不跳档。

reviewMarks.text: More importantly, the class taught me to slow down and notice the beauty around me.
reviewMarks.note: 读者最想要的一句话落纸：要点②感想——这堂课改变了我什么，Chris 读到这句才算收到这封信的分量。

writing.modelAnswer:
I ran back to Gunter and told him the bad news. To my surprise, he simply waved his hand and laughed. "Just catch your bus," he said, writing his number down on a piece of paper and pressing it into my hand. "Pay me when you come back." Touched by such trust from a stranger, I promised I would return every cent. No sooner had I got into the last seat than the doors hissed shut, and through the window I watched his big smile shining in the rain.
Four days later, when I was back in Vienna, I called Gunter as promised. He insisted on picking me up at the airport. When I pressed the fare into his hand, along with a gift from Prague, he smiled that familiar smile. "I knew you'd come," he said. Driving home that night, I understood that a little trust between strangers can light up the coldest, wettest evening.

continuationDesign.theme: 陌生人之间的善意与信任——以诚相待，信任终被善意回馈，温暖能照亮最寒冷的夜（人与社会）。
paragraphs: 承接 starter1 后先用一句'To my surprise, he simply waved his hand and laughed'把 Gunter 的反应接住，制造与读者预期相反的转折——不是催债而是大方放手，既符合他一路热心、乐观的人设，又同时拆掉'付不出钱'和'赶不上车'两个危机。让他塞纸条、说'回来再还'，把全文的善意推向'信任陌生人'这一更高点；叙述者被打动后许诺'return every cent'，正是为 starter2 的 as promised 埋下钩子。结尾用上车与车门关闭的动作链，并回收原文 big smile 意象收束本段。

承接 starter2 的'依约回电'后，让叙述者真的回来还钱、并带一份布拉格小礼物，形成善意的双向回馈——既兑现段1的承诺，又升级了人物关系。Gunter 一句'I knew you'd come'回应他先前的信任、再次绽放熟悉的笑容（呼应贯穿全文的 big smile）。最后用'light up the coldest, wettest evening'直接回扣原文开篇'a cold, wet... evening'，把具体小事提炼成'信任照亮寒夜'的主旨，完成点题与前后呼应。

highlightExpressions.text: writing his number down on a piece of paper and pressing it into my hand
highlightExpressions.note: 动作链：用两个非谓语(writing... down / pressing)串联连续动作并精确到身体部位(hand)，把'给联系方式'写得有画面感。迁移：凡'递东西/做一连串动作'都可用 V-ing 串联 + 落到具体身体部位来细化。

highlightExpressions.text: Touched by such trust from a stranger, I promised I would return every cent
highlightExpressions.note: 心理描写 + 过去分词短语作状语：用 Touched by... 把情绪前置说明动作动因，比 I was touched 更紧凑高级。迁移：写'因某情绪而做某事'时，用过去分词短语(Moved/Frightened/Encouraged by...)开头作状语。

highlightExpressions.text: No sooner had I got into the last seat than the doors hissed shut
highlightExpressions.note: 高级记叙句（No sooner...than 倒装）+ 拟声动词 hissed：表达'刚…就…'的紧迫衔接，画面与节奏感强。迁移：叙事中两件事接连紧逼发生时套用 No sooner had + 过去分词…than…（注意助动词提前倒装）。

highlightExpressions.text: through the window I watched his big smile shining in the rain
highlightExpressions.note: 环境烘托 + 意象回收：用 watched sb./sth. doing 的感官结构，让'笑容在雨中发亮'以正衬反差(暖笑 vs 冷雨)收束，并回收原文 big smile。迁移：分别动作可用'透过窗/门 + watch sb. doing'定格画面，并复用前文意象呼应。

highlightExpressions.text: a little trust between strangers can light up the coldest, wettest evening
highlightExpressions.note: 点题升华句 + 前后呼应：用比喻 light up 把抽象'信任'具象成光，并以 coldest, wettest evening 回扣原文开篇的 cold, wet evening。迁移：结尾点题时把抽象主题(trust/kindness/courage)接一个'照亮/温暖/改变'类动词，再回收开头的环境词形成首尾呼应。
